test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

The cashier admitted that he __was make a mistake__.
solution:
The correct answer is **'had made a mistake'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** 'was'** is the past tense of 'is' and is used for **singular forms** while the word **'had'** is the past tense of 'have' and is used for both** singular **and **plural forms**.
 
• Here, the given sentence must be in **past perfect tense**, where 'had' acts as an** auxiliary verb** **('had' + Past Participle')**.
 
• So, the part of the sentence **'was make a mistake****' **is incorrect and must be replaced with** 'had made a mistake'**.

Thus, the **correct sentence** is: The cashier admitted that he** had made a mistake**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A **linguistic phrase **referring to an activity that took place before the aforementioned time in the past is the **past perfect tense**.
 
• In most cases, **past perfect tense **refers to** (Had + Past Participle of the main verb)**.
 
• The phrases, **'we had thought'** and **'he had made'** are some examples.
